structured_output.summary: The finding is about how strong the test is, not about the code. touch-controls.ts already draws icon('bolt'), but the existing AC8 test only checks that the button has some `svg polygon`, and every icon has one. I left src/ unchanged and added tests/ui/action-button-icon.test.ts. It syncs a pickup RaceView into the race UI (unarmed, then armed), finds the button by its accessible name "Boost", and checks that its SVG polygons are exactly ['14,2 4,14 11,14 9,22 20,9 13,9'], the lightning bolt's points. Red/green: with the verifier's mutation applied (icon('bolt') → icon('play') at touch-controls.ts:41) the new test fails. After putting the line back it passes. pnpm typecheck passes, and pnpm test passes (117 files, 754 tests).
